title: Route Activation Contract
description: Typed, verifiable contract that separates primary route, secondary routes, cross-cutting disciplines, and audits. Generated at preflight, re-verified at delivery. Designed for embedding in Markdown ```contract fenced blocks.

closest_alternative.description: Canonical id of the closest alternative route considered and rejected

boundary_judgment.description: Why the primary route was chosen over the closest alternative. Required when closest_alternative is set.

checked_conditions.description: Hard-fail conditions of the alternative route that were checked

why_not_alternative.description: Why the alternative route's conditions do not apply to this task

switch_conditions.description: Under what conditions the route should be switched to the alternative

secondary_routes.description: Specialized routes used as secondary — each has independent hard-fail verification. Must be route ids (NOT discipline ids).

disciplines.description: Cross-cutting disciplines applied to this task. These are NOT routes and NOT secondary routes.

audits.description: Verification actions run against the final artifact or process artifact

id.description: Audit identifier (checklist file stem without .md extension, or special audit name)

evidence.description: Concrete reference to evidence location in artifact. Must be non-empty when status=passed.

boundary_judgment.why_not_alternative: Task requires investment-style judgment with valuation, not just positioning classification
boundary_judgment.switch_conditions: If the task shifts from investment memo to pure tier classification without valuation burden
